descricao_original: Oxygenated blood from alveolar capillaries flows into small pulmonary venules that gradually anastomose into larger veins. These vessels do not accompany respiratory passageways; instead, they travel alone, frequently seen in the connective tissue that supports the lung. 200x
creditos_identificados: Image source: This image was taken of a slide in the University of Michigan collection.
